title.en: Unit 2 Notes — Specifications of Civil Engineering Works
title.gu: યુનિટ 2 Notes — Civil Engineering Works ના Specifications

body.en: A specification defines the quality, materials, workmanship, performance, tests and measurement/payment basis of work. Drawings show location and dimensions; the specification says what is to be supplied and how acceptance will be checked. Together with contract conditions, they support fair pricing, procurement, inspection and dispute resolution. A general specification states broad quality and scope; a detailed item specification sets material, execution, testing and measurement requirements. Performance and prescriptive specifications differ in how outcomes and methods are stated.
body.gu: Specification કામની quality, materials, workmanship, performance, tests અને measurement/payment basis નિર્ધારિત કરે છે. Drawings સ્થાન અને dimensions બતાવે છે; specification શું આપવું અને acceptance કેવી રીતે ચકાસવું તે જણાવે છે. Contract conditions સાથે તે યોગ્ય pricing, procurement, inspection અને disputes માં મદદ કરે છે. General specification વ્યાપક ગુણવત્તા અને scope બતાવે છે; detailed item specification materials, execution, testing અને measurement ની વિગતો આપે છે. Performance અને prescriptive specification માં outcome અને method દર્શાવવાની રીત અલગ છે.

body.en:
Write clear, complete, measurable and unambiguous requirements consistent with drawings, current standards, project conditions and the applicable PWD/R&B schedule. Identify the item, material grade and source requirements, preparation, execution, curing or protection, tests and acceptance, measurement unit and what the rate includes. Avoid vague terms such as “best quality” without a measurable requirement; avoid unnecessary brand restriction unless contract rules justify it. If documents conflict, follow the stated order of precedence and seek clarification; do not silently assume.

General textbook examples are not a substitute for the exact current Gujarat R&B SOR item, location-specific amendments or contract specification. Record the SOR year, item number, unit, lead/lift and included labour/materials before pricing.
body.gu:
Drawings, current standards, site conditions અને લાગુ PWD/R&B schedule સાથે મેળ ખાતી સ્પષ્ટ, સંપૂર્ણ, માપી શકાય તેવી અને નિર્વિવાદ requirements લખો. Item, material grade અને source requirements, preparation, execution, curing અથવા protection, tests તથા acceptance, measurement unit અને rate માં શું સામેલ છે તે દર્શાવો. માપી ન શકાય એવા “best quality” જેવા શબ્દો ટાળો; contract rules વગર અનાવશ્યક brand restriction ન મૂકો. Documents માં વિરોધ હોય તો order of precedence અનુસરી clarification લો; ચૂપચાપ ધારણા ન કરો.

Textbook examples, current Gujarat R&B SOR ના ચોક્કસ item, સ્થાનિક amendments કે contract specification નો વિકલ્પ નથી. Pricing પહેલાં SOR year, item number, unit, lead/lift અને સામેલ labour/materials નોંધો.

h.en: 2.3 Specifications for earthwork, masonry and concrete

items.syllabus_item: 2.3 PWD/R&B specifications of earthwork brickwork concrete stonework

body.en:
Earthwork: describe soil classification, excavation limits and levels, lead/lift, dewatering, shoring, stacking, disposal and backfilling/compaction as applicable. Brick masonry: state brick class or strength, mortar proportion or specified mix, bond, joint thickness, laying, scaffolding, curing and opening treatment. Stone masonry: identify stone, dressing, mortar, bond stones, hearting and pointing. Concrete/RCC: state grade or approved mix, aggregate size, batching, mixing, placing, compaction, curing and testing; separately identify whether reinforcement, formwork and pumping are included or measured separately.

For each item use the actual drawing, current standard and project SOR entry. Do not quote a generic mortar ratio or labour productivity as an official item specification.
body.gu:
Earthwork: Soil classification, excavation limits તથા levels, lead/lift, dewatering, shoring, stacking, disposal અને લાગુ backfilling/compaction દર્શાવો. Brick masonry: Brick class અથવા strength, mortar proportion અથવા specified mix, bond, joint thickness, laying, scaffolding, curing અને openings દર્શાવો. Stone masonry: Stone, dressing, mortar, bond stones, hearting અને pointing નક્કી કરો. Concrete/RCC: Grade અથવા approved mix, aggregate size, batching, mixing, placing, compaction, curing અને testing લખો; reinforcement, formwork તથા pumping સામેલ છે કે અલગ માપાય છે તે સ્પષ્ટ કરો.

દરેક item માટે વાસ્તવિક drawing, current standard અને project SOR entry અનુસરો. સામાન્ય mortar ratio કે labour productivity ને official item specification તરીકે રજૂ ન કરો.

h.en: 2.4 Specifications for finishing, openings and steel
h.gu: 2.4 Finishing, openings અને steel ના specifications

items.syllabus_item: 2.3 roof floor plaster doors windows wood steel whitewash distemper paint

body.en:
Roofing and flooring: state substrate, material, thickness, slope, joints, waterproofing and finishing. Plaster: state preparation, coat thickness, mortar, finishing and curing. Doors and windows: describe frame and shutter material, size, treatment, fittings, glazing, installation and measurement unit. Wood work: specify species or permitted grade, seasoning, preservative and jointing. Steel: identify steel grade, fabrication, welding or bolts, surface preparation and protective coating. Whitewashing, distemper and painting: specify surface preparation, primer where applicable, number of coats, materials and drying conditions.

Rate inclusions differ: handles, glazing, scaffolding, transport or protection may be included in one SOR item and separate in another. Cross-check before making the abstract.
body.gu:
Roofing અને flooring: Substrate, material, thickness, slope, joints, waterproofing અને finishing દર્શાવો. Plaster: Preparation, coat thickness, mortar, finish અને curing લખો. Doors અને windows: Frame તથા shutter material, size, treatment, fittings, glazing, installation અને measurement unit સ્પષ્ટ કરો. Wood work: Species અથવા મંજૂર grade, seasoning, preservative અને jointing દર્શાવો. Steel: Grade, fabrication, welding અથવા bolts, surface preparation અને protective coating લખો. Whitewashing, distemper અને painting: Surface preparation, લાગુ primer, coats ની સંખ્યા, materials અને drying conditions દર્શાવો.

Rate inclusions અલગ હોઈ શકે: handles, glazing, scaffolding, transport અથવા protection એક SOR item માં સામેલ અને બીજા માં અલગ હોઈ શકે. Abstract બનાવતા પહેલાં તપાસો.

body.en:
Given: A 5 m × 3 m wall face has a 1.2 m × 1.0 m window. For this example the specified measurement rule requires a full deduction of the opening on this face, without separate reveals. Find the measured area.

Step 1. Find gross face area.

Gross area = 5 × 3Gross area = 15 m²

Step 2. Deduct the specified opening area.

Opening area = 1.2 × 1.0Opening area = 1.2 m²Measured area = 15 − 1.2

Final answer:

Measured area = 13.8 m².
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: 5 m × 3 m wall face માં 1.2 m × 1.0 m window છે. આ દાખલામાં specified measurement rule મુજબ આ face પરથી સંપૂર્ણ opening deduct થાય છે અને reveals અલગ નથી. Measured area શોધો.

Step 1. Gross face area ગણો.

Gross area = 5 × 3Gross area = 15 m²

Step 2. નિર્ધારિત opening area બાદ કરો.

Opening area = 1.2 × 1.0Opening area = 1.2 m²Measured area = 15 − 1.2

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Measured area = 13.8 m².

body.en:
Given: The specified painting item has a measured area of 80 m² and an inclusive rate of ₹150/m². Find the item amount.

Step 1. Multiply quantity and inclusive rate.

Amount = 80 × 150

Final answer:

Item amount = ₹12,000.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Specified painting item નું measured area 80 m² અને inclusive rate ₹150/m² છે. Item amount શોધો.

Step 1. Quantity અને inclusive rate નો ગુણાકાર કરો.

Amount = 80 × 150

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Item amount = ₹12,000.

body.en:
Given: Four identical pits are each 1.5 m × 1.5 m × 1.2 m deep. Find excavation volume under the stated dimensions.

Step 1. Calculate one pit.

One pit = 1.5 × 1.5 × 1.2One pit = 2.7 m³

Step 2. Multiply by the number of pits.

Total volume = 4 × 2.7

Final answer:

Excavation = 10.8 m³.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: ચાર સમાન pits દરેક 1.5 m × 1.5 m × 1.2 m ઊંડા છે. આપેલ dimensions મુજબ excavation volume ગણો.

Step 1. એક pit નું volume ગણો.

One pit = 1.5 × 1.5 × 1.2One pit = 2.7 m³

Step 2. Pits ની સંખ્યાથી ગુણો.

Total volume = 4 × 2.7

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Excavation = 10.8 m³.

title.en: Formulae, methods and key data — Unit 2
title.gu: Formulae, methods અને key data — યુનિટ 2

body.en:
Record item number, unit, materials, execution, tests and included charges; formulae apply only under stated measurement rules.

Item amount = quantity × inclusive unit rateRectangular excavation volume = number × length × breadth × depthNet area = gross area − applicable deductions + eligible additions
body.gu:
Item number, unit, materials, execution, tests અને included charges નોંધો; સૂત્રો આપેલા measurement rules હેઠળ જ લાગુ છે.

Item amount = quantity × inclusive unit rateRectangular excavation volume = number × length × breadth × depthNet area = gross area − applicable deductions + eligible additions

q.en: What is a specification?
q.gu: Specification શું છે?

a.en: A statement of material, execution and performance requirements.
a.gu: Material, execution અને performance requirements નું નિવેદન.

q.en: What is a general specification?
q.gu: General specification શું છે?

a.en: A broad description of quality and scope.
a.gu: Quality અને scope નું વ્યાપક વર્ણન.

q.en: What is a detailed specification?
q.gu: Detailed specification શું છે?

a.en: Item-specific material, workmanship, tests and measurement details.
a.gu: Item-specific material, workmanship, tests અને measurement ની વિગતો.

q.en: Why specify workmanship?
q.gu: Workmanship કેમ સ્પષ્ટ કરવું?

a.en: It determines the required execution quality.

q.en: What is an SOR?
q.gu: SOR શું છે?

a.en: A schedule of rates for described items.
a.gu: વર્ણવેલ items માટે rates નું schedule.

q.en: Why record the SOR year?
q.gu: SOR year કેમ નોંધવો?

a.en: Rates and item provisions change over time.
a.gu: Rates અને item provisions સમય સાથે બદલાય છે.

q.en: Does RCC always include steel in its rate?
q.gu: RCC rate માં steel હંમેશાં સામેલ હોય છે?

a.en: No; check the exact item and contract.
a.gu: નહીં; ચોક્કસ item અને contract તપાસો.

q.en: What should earthwork specification include?
q.gu: Earthwork specification માં શું આવવું જોઈએ?

a.en: Soil, dimensions, lead, lift and disposal as applicable.
a.gu: લાગુ soil, dimensions, lead, lift અને disposal.

q.en: Why specify curing for masonry?
q.gu: Masonry માટે curing કેમ લખવું?

a.en: To obtain the required mortar performance.

q.en: Are drawings a substitute for specifications?
q.gu: Drawings એ specifications નો વિકલ્પ છે?

q.en: How should ambiguous requirements be handled?
q.gu: અસ્પષ્ટ requirements માટે શું કરવું?

q.en: Why state measurement unit?
q.gu: Measurement unit કેમ દર્શાવવું?

a.en: To price and pay for the correct quantity.
a.gu: સાચી quantity માટે pricing અને payment કરવા.

q.en: Explain the purpose and types of specification.
q.gu: Specification નો હેતુ અને પ્રકારો સમજાવો.

q.en: State the principles of writing a detailed item specification.
q.gu: Detailed item specification લખવાના સિદ્ધાંતો જણાવો.

q.en: Write an illustrative specification for brick masonry, including workmanship and curing.
q.gu: Workmanship અને curing સાથે brick masonry નું illustrative specification લખો.

q.en: Write an illustrative specification for concrete or excavation and explain rate inclusions.
q.gu: Concrete અથવા excavation નું illustrative specification લખી rate inclusions સમજાવો.

q.en: Distinguish general and detailed specifications.
q.gu: General અને detailed specifications નો તફાવત આપો.

q.en: List the essential items in a plaster specification.
q.gu: Plaster specification ના જરૂરી મુદ્દા લખો.

q.en: List the essential items in a door or window specification.
q.gu: Door અથવા window specification ના જરૂરી મુદ્દા લખો.

q.en: Explain why the SOR year and item unit are important.
q.gu: SOR year અને item unit કેમ મહત્વના છે તે સમજાવો.
